notes: IB Tracker now runs in a browser, so you no longer need a Mac to use it. Open it at ib-tracker.github.io/app, and it works on a Windows laptop, a Chromebook, a school computer, anything. Nothing to download and nothing to install.

The browser version comes with 30 days free rather than 7, because trying something properly takes more than a week when you are in the middle of term. The Mac app keeps its 7-day trial, still runs completely offline, and a license key works on both.
Your work is still yours either way. In a browser it is stored by that browser and never sent to a server, exactly as the Mac app stores it on your Mac.
